notes: The waw before עֹשֵׁק is unrepresented because rule 41 gives the supplied relative *that* to the articleless attributive participle itself; rule 17's waw-as-relative governs a finite verb, not an attributive participle.
*leaveth* is a supplied lexical verb outside rule 20's copula boundary; the existential אַיִן carries only *no*. The marginal literal gloss *without food* was read and set aside under rule 38.
